cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it rained all evening. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked why you crashed my car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And before that you asked whether the roads were wet. They were.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The forecast said showers. I should answer that original question completely.

mechanism: A directs an accident account while yielding its format to B but keeps supplying an earlier harmless weather answer instead of taking driving blame.
confusable: Generic topic-changing lacks a sincerely answered safer question already identified earlier in this same interaction.
comparison: Lunch alternative concerns a birthday-cake accusation rather than a damaged car and written account.
seedUse: Weather seed supplies explicit earlier questions; S02 requires A to adapt reporting procedure while keeping the answer evasively old.
